en: The image shows a historical black-and-white postcard with a panoramic view of a city topped by a large and prominent mosque with multiple minarets, likely the Selimiye Mosque. The foreground features two oval portraits: on the left, a military officer in a European-style uniform, and on the right, another military figure in Ottoman-style attire. Between them is a piece of bulleted or poetic text in Bulgarian. Below the image is a caption in Bulgarian providing information about the elements depicted.
